name: Alyissia
summary: In Aldrassil, Alyissia trains young night elves to fight with strength and discipline. She teaches warriors how to defend the young world tree.

sections.title: Martial Mentor of Shadowglen
sections.body: Alyissia trains young night elves inside Aldrassil, where they learn to fight with steel and shield instead of nature magic or the priesthood. Kaldorei forces are known for their Sentinels and stealthy archers, but danger across Kalimdor also calls for fighters who can hold the front line. Alyissia teaches the first techniques: how to direct battle fury, master a stance, and withstand the wild creatures and corrupted grells that press into Shadowglen.

faq.answer: Alyissia trains new night elf warriors in Aldrassil, the heart of Shadowglen. She gives them their first lessons and simple martial exercises as they begin training in Teldrassil.
Alyissia is on the ground level inside Aldrassil's great hollow trunk, at the heart of Shadowglen in Teldrassil.
Alyissia receives the Simple Sigil carried by new night elf warriors. It introduces them to their warrior trainer in Aldrassil.

angles.text: As a night elf warrior, Alyissia is your first mentor. She teaches early stances and martial discipline before you venture farther into Teldrassil's wilds.
As a night elf, you can learn the kaldorei's front-line martial discipline from Alyissia, preparing to defend Aldrassil's roots from corruption.
